# CG-SCHEMA-900: Unsupported schema construct changed

A schema keyword ContractGuard does not analyze changed.

**Why it matters:** Unknown impact is reported as undetermined rather than guessed.

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Area | [Schemas](./#schema) |
| Detects | `schema.unsupportedChanged`, `schema.propertyAdded`, `schema.propertyRemoved` |
| Severity | breaking: high · potentially breaking: medium · undetermined: medium |
| Classification can be overridden | no (the rule only fires when the change is breaking by definition) |

## Message

> {what} changed in {where} and was not analyzed.
>
> ContractGuard v1 does not evaluate these keywords, so the compatibility impact is unknown.
>
> **Fix:** Review the change manually.

## Examples

Each example is an executed test case of the rule (`packages/engine/test/compat/fixtures.ts`).

### Fires: if/then/else edited

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      post:
-       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object, if: {required: [a]}, then: {required: [b]}}}}}
+       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object, if: {required: [a]}, then: {required: [c]}}}}}
        responses: {'204': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** Undetermined, medium. `then` changed in POST /x: the request body (application/json) and was not analyzed.

### Fires: not added

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get:
-       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: string}}}}}
+       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: string, not: {const: x}}}}}}
```

**Result:** Undetermined, medium. `not` changed in GET /x: response 200 (application/json) and was not analyzed.

### Fires: property added under unevaluatedProperties

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      post:
-       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object, unevaluatedProperties: false}}}}
+       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object, unevaluatedProperties: false, properties: {a: {}}}}}}
        responses: {'204': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** Undetermined, medium. Property "a" under unevaluated/pattern properties changed in POST /x: the request body (application/json) and was not analyzed.

### Does not fire: unsupported keyword unchanged

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      post:
        requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object, if: {required: [a]}, then: {required: [b]}}}}}
        responses: {'204': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.

## Limitations

- By definition.
